summary: Never exited - held the full 15-frame window. The trade oscillated in a wide band (roughly +2.75 to -9.00pts) with reversion_prob staying elevated (0.85-1.00) across timeframes on nearly every frame, and each deep push against the position (-4.75, -6.00, -9.00) was followed by a partial recovery with with-position fires (HA/PROPP) confirming, so no single frame presented a clean structural break to justify cutting. In hindsight the -9.00pt low at t=12m with zero confirming fires was the point of maximum risk; next time I'd weight a lack of any fires during a new-low push more heavily as a signal to tighten out, rather than leaning on reversion_prob alone which stayed high throughout even as price kept making lower lows.
